# Design point P024

## Description

The system maintains at least three replicas of each repository, with the Spokes architecture coordinating geographically separated copies and supporting continued push acceptance after one failure. Single-pack full repacking is rejected, so this combination does not adopt that full-rewrite compaction method; the replication mechanism’s mixed status indicates qualification or unresolved fit.
